stories.title: Delhi Police maintains 60-day prohibitive orders
stories.summary: Delhi Police has imposed 60-day prohibitive orders under Section 163 of the BNSS in the capital. The restrictions, which limit free movement, were enacted following protests over NEET-UG leaks and CEC resignation demands. The orders remain in effect until late November. The capital is currently under notice.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu CM reiterates opposition to NEET
stories.summary: Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay told a Union government task force that Tamil Nadu remains opposed to NEET and similar entrance exams. The state government prefers using Class XII public examination marks for higher education admissions. The task force is currently reviewing national examination reforms.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu CM pushes for Supreme Court Bench in Chennai
stories.summary: Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi requesting a Supreme Court Bench in Chennai. The state first proposed the move in 1980, citing the travel burden on litigants from southern states. The Constitution allows the court to sit in other locations.

stories.title: Supreme Court reviews ECI voter enrolment process
stories.summary: The Supreme Court is monitoring the Election Commission of India after it continued to require excluded voters to use Form 6. The court previously ruled that forcing pre-existing voters to re-register as new applicants was an error. The ECI has not updated its stance on the forms.

stories.title: Supreme Court questions immunity for election officials
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has issued notice to the Centre regarding a law granting lifelong immunity to the Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners. The provision protects officials from criminal prosecution both during and after their tenure. The court is examining the constitutionality of the appointment law.

stories.title: Supreme Court to review EC voter roll clarification
stories.summary: The Supreme Court will hear a plea on November 19 regarding the Election Commission's decision to allow omitted voters to re-enrol via Form 6. The court has asked the commission to consider extending deadlines if necessary. Petitioners remain concerned about the ongoing intensive roll revision.

stories.title: Supreme Court rules on anti-defection case timelines
stories.summary: The Supreme Court ordered the Madhya Pradesh Speaker to resolve a disqualification petition against MLA Nirmala Sapre within two months. The court ruled that an assembly's remaining tenure is not a valid reason to delay anti-defection cases. High courts are expected to ensure prompt rulings.

stories.title: Supreme Court seeks response from Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge to respond to a petition regarding the October 12 march to the court complex. The event resulted in a large gathering and a reported injury to a journalist. The court is investigating their role in the protest.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi renews debate challenge to PM Modi
stories.summary: Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi has renewed his challenge for an open debate with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Home Minister Amit Shah stated the government is prepared to discuss all issues, including electoral rolls and EVMs, within the formal setting of a special Parliament session.

stories.title: Finance Minister urges debate in Parliament
stories.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has criticised Rahul Gandhi for his social media debate challenges, suggesting he instead address the Prime Minister in Parliament. She accused the Congress party of avoiding formal legislative responses in the past. Demanding answers comes with the obligation to hear them.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi maintains open debate offer
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi has reminded the Prime Minister that his challenge for a public debate remains unanswered after 24 hours. The Congress MP suggested the RSS chief could serve as a judge for the discussion. The Prime Minister has not yet responded to the proposal.

stories.title: Indian sailor dies in drone attack near Hormuz Strait
stories.summary: A 25-year-old Indian sailor from Gujarat died following a suspected drone attack on a cargo vessel near the Strait of Hormuz. The family plans to conduct the burial in Oman due to administrative delays. The vessel was registered in Jamnagar and carried 14 crew members.

stories.title: Telangana bus conductor dies after fall
stories.summary: A 24-year-old bus conductor in Telangana has died after being pushed from a moving vehicle by a passenger. The incident triggered widespread protests by transport employees in the Khammam region. The accused remains the subject of demands for stringent punishment.

stories.title: Women enter roles in Singareni coal mines
stories.summary: Women are increasingly taking on roles in Telangana’s Singareni coal mines, including handling explosives and operating heavy machinery. The industry, traditionally dominated by men, is seeing a shift as women participate in mine rescue operations and underground supervision. Stereotypes are being challenged in the sector.

stories.title: Autorickshaw driving provides path for Mysuru women
stories.summary: Driving an autorickshaw has become a primary source of income for 45 women in Mysuru. Many of these drivers entered the profession following the death of their husbands. The work allows them to serve as the sole breadwinners for their families while maintaining self-reliance.

stories.title: Two arrested for assault in Hyderabad
stories.summary: Police in Hyderabad have arrested two men following the circulation of a video showing the assault of two women. The suspects allegedly confronted the women over claims of religious conversion. The incident reportedly occurred last month, and police are currently verifying the details of the case.

stories.title: Second Indian victim of Riyadh airport attack dies
stories.summary: A second Indian national has died following the October 10 attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. The Indian Embassy confirmed the death and stated it is assisting the family with funeral arrangements. The embassy remains in contact with the bereaved relatives.

stories.title: Jaipur student found dead in lake
stories.summary: A Class 8 student was found dead in Talkatora Lake in Jaipur on Wednesday. The girl had been reported missing by her family earlier that morning. Police stated the family reported she was upset regarding her recent exam marks. The investigation is ongoing.

stories.summary: Bengal man arrested from temple with wife's severed head, neighbours allege marital discord The arrested man was identified as 46-year-old Rintu Sarkar, a former bus conductor for the state-owned North Bengal State Transport Corporation. A man was arrested from Bengal's South Dinajpur district on Wednesday

stories.title: Startups release sovereign AI models for offline use
stories.summary: Government-backed startups Soket AI and ZenteiQ have released sovereign AI models designed for air-gapped environments. These systems operate without internet connectivity to provide secure coding and research capabilities. The models were unveiled in New Delhi in the presence of IT Ministry officials and India AI Mission representatives.

stories.title: Over 50% of startups in Tamil Nadu are led by women, says StartupTN Chairman
stories.summary: Currently, Tamil Nadu has over 16,000 registered startups, and of these, 50.8% are women-led firms, Singai G. Ramachandran, Chairman of StartupTN, said on Tuesday. Speaking at the Best of Best (BoB) Conference and Awards 2026, he also addressed the issue of creating infrastructure for women.

stories.title: INCOIS warns of Marine Heat Wave, issues swell surge alert for east and west coasts
stories.summary: The Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS), a research organisation under the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), has issued a Marine Heat Wave (MHW) warning across the Arabian Sea, the Indian Ocean and the Bay of Bengal. The warming conditions could adversely affect

stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh Water Resources Minister Nimmala Ramanaidu has directed irrigation officials to remain on high alert in view of heavy rainfall triggered by Cyclone Murasu and take immediate steps to drain rainwater stagnating in agricultural fields to prevent further damage to crops. During a teleconference

stories.title: Iran exempts four nations from Hormuz transit restrictions
stories.summary: Iran has exempted merchant vessels from India, China, Iraq, and Qatar from restrictions on using the Strait of Hormuz. An Iranian lawmaker stated the measure aims to facilitate medicine procurement from India. The official added that the US is not currently stopping these ships from passing freely.

stories.title: Indian national dies following Riyadh airport attack
stories.summary: An Indian national wounded in a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport last month has died in the ICU, according to the Indian embassy. This brings the total number of Indian citizens killed since the West Asia conflict began in February to 24. The embassy confirmed the death Wednesday.

stories.title: India urges diplomacy as West Asia conflict disrupts supplies
stories.summary: India has reiterated calls for dialogue to halt hostilities in West Asia, citing the debilitating impact on global energy, food, and fertiliser supplies. The government noted that the conflict has caused a heavy toll, including the death of 23 Indian nationals, following recent strikes on Iran.

stories.title: Israel opposition moves to replace Netanyahu administration
stories.summary: Israel's opposition parties have agreed to rally behind Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot as their candidate for prime minister. The coalition, which describes the current administration as the 7/10 government, aims to use its majority in the 26th Knesset to establish a new government at the earliest.

stories.title: Indian seafarer killed in attack near Oman
stories.summary: An Indian seafarer died after a commercial vessel was struck by an unidentified aerial object near the Oman coast on Monday. This incident brings the total number of Indian nationals killed in the West Asia conflict to 23, of which 15 were seafarers. The vessel carried 14 crew members.

stories.title: Indian tourist killed in Everest helicopter collision
stories.summary: A 47-year-old tourist from Chennai was killed and two others were injured when two helicopters collided near a helipad close to Mount Everest on Tuesday. Aviation authorities suspect miscommunication between the pilots, who were operating near the base camp while evacuating tourists and transporting cargo.

stories.title: Government issues advisory on IT law compliance
stories.summary: The information and broadcasting ministry has issued an advisory to OTT platforms and digital news publishers, seeking strict adherence to the Information Technology Act. The document flags nine areas for greater care, including the time-stamping of visuals and the use of AI-generated content by all digital players.

stories.title: Bengaluru company tests inflatable space habitat technology
stories.summary: Akashalabdhi Space has completed a high-altitude flight test of an experimental inflatable structure. The 25kg mission reached approximately 30km using a balloon facility in Hyderabad. The company aims to demonstrate technologies for building future orbital factories and expandable space habitats through these near-space trials.

stories.title: Danish minister visits India to boost green energy ties
stories.summary: Danish business minister Martin Lidegaard visited India this week to strengthen the Green Strategic Partnership. The visit focused on innovation, maritime affairs, and trade. Lidegaard described India as an increasingly important partner for Denmark across economic, technological, and geopolitical sectors as the two nations expand their cooperation.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu reports no major veterinary disease outbreak
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu's Minister for Animal Husbandry stated there is no major outbreak of veterinary diseases in the state. Vaccination camps are ongoing and medicines are provided free of cost at government hospitals. The minister also advised against bursting crackers near cattle during the upcoming Deepavali festival.

stories.title: Telangana minister reviews hospital construction progress
stories.summary: Telangana Health Minister C. Damodar Raja Narasimha has directed officials to expedite pending works at the Warangal Super Specialty Hospital. The minister reviewed infrastructure progress at multiple medical institutes, aiming to ensure facilities are fully equipped to provide comprehensive services ahead of their scheduled inaugurations.

stories.title: Delhi High Court seeks safety review of Ranitidine
stories.summary: The Delhi High Court has issued a notice to the Centre and drug regulatory authorities regarding the pending safety review of the acidity medication Ranitidine. The petition contends that safety concerns surrounding the drug have remained unresolved since September 2019, requiring a stipulated time frame for completion.

stories.title: Panel proposes merit-based changes to NEET-PG
stories.summary: An expert panel has proposed replacing the percentile-based qualifying system for NEET-PG with a rank-based merit system. The recommendations include reducing fees for non-clinical courses, revising resident stipends, and using biometric verification to prevent seat blocking. The proposal was filed in an affidavit to the Supreme Court.

stories.title: Urologists assigned to emergency departments in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Twelve government urologists who completed their training in 2025 are currently working as casualty medical officers in emergency departments. Sources indicate that no new posts have been created in urology departments for years, leaving several government medical college hospitals without dedicated urology services.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu to pilot perinatal mental health screening
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu is preparing to pilot an initiative to screen pregnant women for mental health issues at primary healthcare centres. Village health nurses and medical officers are being trained to facilitate care for depression. Global studies cited by the Institute of Mental Health suggest high prevalence rates.

stories.title: IMD study finds southern India has become wetter
stories.summary: A study by the India Meteorological Department found that southern India has grown wetter over the past seven decades. The area classified as a hot semi-arid climate has nearly halved, with much of the region transitioning into a tropical savannah climate zone that receives more consistent rainfall.

stories.title: IGCAR director links coastal sand to India's nuclear future
stories.summary: Sreekumar G. Pillai, director of the Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research, says thorium found in coastal mineral sands is a potential energy source for the nation's three-stage nuclear programme. He spoke at a symposium regarding the role of fast reactors. The sand is currently being evaluated.

stories.title: Shashi Tharoor suggests quockerwodger as political term
stories.summary: Congress leader Shashi Tharoor has proposed the word quockerwodger as an alternative to common political labels. He defines the term as a political puppet controlled by others. The MP is known for sharing obscure vocabulary that frequently requires his social media followers to consult a dictionary.

stories.title: Sam Altman updates display name to Ram Altman
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman changed his name on X to Ram Altman after users mocked his suggestion that personal computers use too much DRAM. Altman argued that cloud computing is a more efficient way to distribute global memory supplies. The internet has responded with a meme fest.

stories.title: Tharoor offers new vocabulary for political discourse
stories.summary: Shashi Tharoor has suggested using the word quockerwodger to describe political puppets who act on the instructions of others. The MP shared the definition on X, offering it as a replacement for existing political slang. His followers are once again reaching for their lexicons.

research.title: Why even a strong El Niño does not guarantee a poor Indian monsoon
research.summary: Seven Indian monsoons since 1950 have run into a moderate or strong El Niño. Of these, in five years, including 2026, monsoon rainfall levels were at least 10% lower than the long-term average. The IMD refers to this level as 'deficient’. The 2023 season was something of an.

research.title: A Guideline-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Exercise Prescription from Clinical and Wearable Data
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Translating population-level exercise guidance into individualized prescriptions requires integrating clinical and wearable data, including diagnoses, medications, functional limitations, and baseline activity, with condition-specific recommendations, a process difficult to scale beyond specialist rehabilitation settings. We developed FITTER. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A hidden star is plowing through Betelgeuse’s atmosphere, new evidence suggests
research.summary: Something mysterious is disturbing Betelgeuse, and astronomers believe they have identified the culprit: a hidden companion star called Siwarha. New radio observations reveal that the smaller star may be plowing through Betelgeuse’s enormous atmosphere, creating disturbances that subtly stretch and distort the red supergiant’s shape.

research.title: Alignment Faking Depends on the Value, Not Just the Model
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models can follow a directive when they believe they are monitored and abandon it when they believe they are not, a pattern termed Alignment Faking. Prior work establishes this for harmful-content objectives and a handful. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CARD: A Proof-Carrying Certificate-to-Action Interface for Relative-Measurement Graphs
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometric certificates make mathematical claims about specified estimator objects, while robotic action requires a physical transform, a service decision, and timely proof support. We present CARD, a proof-carrying interface that keeps these objects distinct and records. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Controlling Action-Head Co-Adaptation to VLM Representation Anisotropy
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern learning systems increasingly combine pretrained models with downstream heads. Despite the growing importance of such modular designs, how the downstream model co-adapts to the geometry of pretrained representations remains relatively underexplored. We study this problem. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Counterexample-driven autonomous research with application to excess radiated energy in a Z-pinch
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in artificial-intelligence-assisted mathematics show that open-ended machine search can outperform human mathematicians, yet transferring this paradigm to physics requires refactoring the research workflow. We introduce Simjecture, an open-source framework in which language-model agents pursue. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
